 Match Preview
 UEFA Nations League A - Game Week 6 15 Nov 2026 - 12:45 Matmut Atlantique France host Turkiye at the Stade Matmut Atlantique in Bordeaux on Sunday night, with Zinedine Zidane's side needing a result to stay in contention for top spot in UEFA Nations League Group A1.
 Les Bleus arrive at this fixture on the back of a chastening 3-1 defeat to Italy at San Siro on Thursday, a result that ended Zidane's unbeaten start as France head coach. Pio Esposito scored twice for the Azzurri, and France's defensive frailties were exposed throughout the second half.
 The situation in the squad has since worsened. Dayot Upamecano has left the group for personal reasons and returned to Bayern Munich, adding to an already lengthy list of absentees that includes William Saliba, Jules Kounde, Maxence Lacroix, Manu Kone, Ousmane Dembele, and Esteban Lepaul.
 The one source of optimism for Zidane is the expected return of Kylian Mbappe to the starting lineup. The Real Madrid forward missed the Italy defeat, and his presence in Bordeaux should sharpen a French attack that struggled for rhythm and speed of play in Milan.
 Turkiye arrive in poor form, having lost all five of their Nations League matches this campaign. Sergen Yalcin's side were beaten 2-1 by Belgium on Thursday and sit bottom of the group with no points to show from the league phase.
 France won the reverse fixture 1-0 in September and will be expected to claim three points again, though Zidane will demand a response in both performance and structure after the defensive collapse against Italy.
